extName.message: Dark Reverse Thread – Gmail dark mode & newest-first
extName.description: Extension name shown in Chrome and the Web Store (max 75 characters).

extShortName.description: Short name for the popup heading and where space is tight.

extDescription.message: True dark mode for Gmail, even inside emails, with their colors kept. Plus newest-first threads: latest reply on top.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in Chrome and the Web Store (max 132 characters).

popupSubtitle.message: Dark mode & newest-first threads for Gmail
popupSubtitle.description: Subtitle under the extension name in the popup.

settingDark.description: Popup setting label: dark mode on/off.

settingDarkDesc.message: Darken conversations and email bodies, keeping their hues
settingDarkDesc.description: Popup setting description for dark mode.

settingReverse.description: Popup setting label: newest-first thread order on/off.

settingReverseDesc.message: Show the newest email at the top
settingReverseDesc.description: Popup setting description for thread reversal.

settingReply.description: Popup setting label: where the reply box is placed.

settingReplyDesc.message: Where the reply box opens in the newest email
settingReplyDesc.description: Popup setting description for reply box position.

replyBottom.description: Reply box position option: right below the newest email (default).

replyTop.description: Reply box position option: above the newest email.

replyNeedsReverse.message: Available when Reverse Thread Order is on
replyNeedsReverse.description: Shown instead of the reply position description (and as the quick bar tooltip) while newest-first order is off.

settingQuickBar.description: Popup setting label: show the floating quick toggle bar.

settingQuickBarDesc.message: Show quick toggles in the bottom-right corner
settingQuickBarDesc.description: Popup setting description for the quick bar.

statusSaved.description: Shown briefly in the popup after a setting changes.

footerTagline.description: Popup footer text shown after the version number.

quickNewest.description: Quick bar button: thread reversal toggle (followed by ON/OFF). Keep short.

quickNewestTitle.description: Tooltip of the quick bar thread reversal button.

quickDark.description: Quick bar button: dark mode toggle (followed by ON/OFF). Keep short.

quickDarkTitle.description: Tooltip of the quick bar dark mode button.

quickReply.description: Quick bar button: reply box position (followed by Top/Bottom). Keep short.

quickReplyTitle.message: Open the reply box above or below the newest email
quickReplyTitle.description: Tooltip of the quick bar reply position button.

quickReplyTop.description: Quick bar: reply box is at the top.

quickReplyBottom.description: Quick bar: reply box is at the bottom.

quickReloadNeeded.message: The extension was updated. Please reload the page.
quickReloadNeeded.description: Quick bar: shown when the extension was reloaded or updated while this Gmail tab stayed open.

rateLink.description: Popup link to the extension's reviews page in the Chrome Web Store.

reportLink.description: Popup link to the project's issue tracker for reporting a problem.

supportLink.message: ☕ Like it? Buy me a coffee
supportLink.description: Popup link to the developer's Buy Me a Coffee page.

tipGmailDarkTheme.message: 💡 Set Gmail's theme to Dark to darken the inbox and the rest of Gmail too.
tipGmailDarkTheme.description: Popup tip, shown only while Gmail uses a light theme.

tipOpenTheme.description: Popup button: opens Gmail's quick settings panel, where the theme can be picked.

openThemeLink.description: Small popup link (shown unless the dark-theme tip is shown): opens Gmail's theme picker.

openThemeNote.message: It may take a moment to open.
openThemeNote.description: Small note under the theme link and button: Gmail's theme picker can take a moment to open.

originalColorsShow.description: Tooltip of the per-message button that shows the email in its own colors

originalColorsHide.description: Tooltip of the same button while the email shows its own colors

composeOriginalShow.description: Tooltip of the button in the reply box / compose toolbar that shows the white page and the colors exactly as the email will be sent

composeOriginalShowWarning.message: Underlined text is hard to read on white: show colors as sent
composeOriginalShowWarning.description: Same tooltip while some text has a color that recipients on a white screen can hardly read (that text is underlined)

themeNotice.message: This extension darkens emails and conversations; the inbox follows Gmail's own theme. Set Gmail's theme to Dark to darken all of Gmail.
themeNotice.description: Notice on the Gmail page (once, until closed) when Gmail uses a light theme

tipDarkReader.message: ⚠️ Dark Reader is darkening Gmail too, and the two can clash (hidden icons, odd colors). For the best look, turn Dark Reader off for mail.google.com. To keep the inbox dark as well, set Gmail's theme to Dark.
tipDarkReader.description: Popup tip, shown only when the open Gmail tab is also darkened by the Dark Reader extension.

darkReaderNoticeOk.description: Button that closes the Dark Reader notice on the Gmail page for good.
